intent: Eight individual media/device tasks distinguish time, silent-mode instructions, intended prevention, slow motion, broadcast channel, bridge function, replacement need and battery location.
picturePurpose: Original cameras with and without attached straps support direct observation. The source supplies prevention purpose; no safety guarantee is inferred. A coded silent-mode task changes a simulated phone without real audio or device settings.

workshop.title: 调静音、辨相机，再核对记录
workshop.instruction: 调好示意手机，点出相机带；分清要求、用途和已经发生的事。

items.label: telephone：电话什么时候响的？
items.material: The telephone rang just as we were leaving.
items.after: rang just as we were leaving.
items.reason: telephone在这里是电话。rang是ring的过去式，just as we were leaving表示就在我们正要离开时，不是已经离开很久。电话响了，不等于有人接听，也没有说明谁打来的。
items.hint: 核对just as；响了不等于接了。

recordSelection.title: 就在正要离开时响起
recordSelection.prompt: 只保留原句支持的记录。

rows.label: 正要离开时响了
rows.text: The telephone rang just as we were leaving.

rows.label: 离开很久后才响
rows.text: The telephone rang long after we had left.

recordSelection.wrong: 只选正要离开时响起；不能改时刻或补已接听。

options.text: The telephone rang long after we had left.
options.reason: 正要离开的时刻被换成离开很久以后。

options.text: The telephone rang at the moment we were leaving.
options.reason: just as把电话响起与正要离开的时刻连起来。

options.text: We answered the telephone before we left.
options.reason: rang只报告响了，没有说谁接听。

items.label: mobile：按图书馆的要求设置手机。
items.prompt: 按图书馆的要求设置手机。
items.material: Keep your mobile on silent in the library.
items.reason: mobile在这里是名词，英式英语中常指手机；也可以作形容词表示移动的。on silent表示调成静音，不是让铃声响，也不等于要求关机。Keep是指令，不能补成已经人人做到。静音不说明震动是否开启。
items.hint: 静音不等于响铃或关机；别补震动状态。

wordDecision.prompt: 按图书馆的要求设置手机。

phoneMode.title: 图书馆里：把示意手机调成静音
phoneMode.hint: 只模拟铃声设置，不改变你的设备，也不发出声音。静音不等于关机。
phoneMode.wrong: 原句要求on silent：应选静音。响铃或关机都没有按本题要求设置。

options.text: Keep the mobile ringing in the library.
options.reason: silent被反转成ringing。

options.text: Every mobile has already been set to silent.
options.reason: Keep是指令，不证明所有人已经照做。

options.text: Keep the mobile in silent mode in the library.
options.reason: on silent要求静音模式，地点是图书馆。

items.label: camera：点出装有相机带的相机。
items.prompt: 点出装有相机带的相机。
items.material: The camera has a strap to prevent drops.
items.after: has a strap to prevent drops.
items.reason: camera表示照相机，a strap是带子。to prevent drops说明装带子的目的，不是说相机永远不会掉落，也没报告已经发生或避免了一次跌落。图能确认带子是否存在，防跌落用途要结合原句。
items.hint: 先辨带子；目的不等于保证。

wordDecision.prompt: 点出装有相机带的相机。

art.alt: 两台相同外形的相机：A左侧装有完整环形带子，B侧面的连接环为空；没有跌落过程。

evidence.caption: A的带子连接机身，并形成完整环圈，符合has a strap。原句给出防跌落用途，不能保证永不掉落。
B侧面的连接环为空，没有装带子，不符合has a strap。

options.text: This camera has an attached strap intended to help prevent drops.
options.reason: A有连接在机身上的带子；防跌落是原句给出的用途，不是效果保证。

options.text: This camera has no strap attached.
options.reason: B没有装带子，不符合has a strap。

items.label: video：视频怎样展示步骤？
items.material: The video shows each step in slow motion.
items.after: shows each step in slow motion.
items.reason: video在这里是视频，复数是videos。each step表示每个步骤，in slow motion是慢动作。慢动作展示不等于画面模糊，也不证明每位观看者已经学会；本题读句意，不需要播放视频。

options.text: The video presents the steps at high speed.
options.reason: slow被反转成high speed。

options.text: The video presents every step in slow motion.

options.text: Every viewer has already learned every step perfectly.

items.label: radio：我们通过什么听到警报？

items.before: We heard the flood warning on the
items.reason: radio可指收音机或广播。on the radio表示通过广播；heard是hear的过去式。原句只报告我们听到洪水警报，没有说谁发布，也没有说之后采取了什么行动。

transfer.stem: Which notes keep the instruction, purpose and remaining need?
transfer.passage:
Our library display
The telephone rang just as we were leaving home. I did not recognise the number, and we were already late. At the library door, a sign said, “Keep your mobile on silent.” I changed the setting and put mine in my bag.
Lina brought a camera with a strap to help prevent drops. We used it to take photos of our display. A short video showed each step of making a paper boat in slow motion. Beside it, a television programme explained how bridges work.
We had heard a flood warning on the radio that morning, so our teacher checked the latest local advice before planning the journey. The remote for the display needs new batteries. There is a spare battery in the front pocket of our bag, but its label is worn. We must check its type and charge before using it.

options.text: The sign requires silent mode; the strap is intended to help prevent drops; the remote still needs new batteries.
The sign proves everyone selected silent mode; the strap is intended to help prevent drops; the remote still needs new batteries.
The sign requires silent mode; the strap guarantees no drops; the remote still needs new batteries.
The sign requires silent mode; the strap is intended to help prevent drops; new batteries are already fitted in the remote.

answer.display: The sign requires silent mode; the strap is intended to help prevent drops; the remote still needs new batteries.

explanation.strategy: 依次区分指令、目的和仍需完成的事。

steps.text: 标牌要求静音，没有报告所有人已经做到；带子用于帮助防跌落，不保证永不掉落。
steps.reason: Keep给出指令；to help prevent表达用途，没有承诺一定不会掉落。

steps.text: 遥控器仍需要新电池，不是已经换好；前袋有备用电池也不证明型号、电量合适。
steps.reason: needs new batteries说明需要；must check保留未完成的检查。

distractors.reason: 把静音指令扩大成所有人已经照做的事实。
把防跌落的目的扩大成永不掉落的保证。
把仍需新电池换成新电池已经装好。

explanation.pitfall: 把要求读成已做到，把目的读成保证，把需要读成已经完成。

visual.title: 要求、目的、需要

segments.note: 指令，未报告所有人照做
